output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply is added to the balanceOf[target] without a check, allowing the owner to set the balance of any user to any value.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] is incremented by _value without a check, allowing the transfer function to be called with a large _value, causing an overflow in balanceOf[_to] and granting arbitrary tokens to any user.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] is incremented by _value without a check, allowing the transferFrom function to be called with a large _value, causing an overflow in balanceOf[_to] and granting arbitrary tokens to any user.

output_list.vulnerability: The buy function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The amount is set to msg.value / buyPrice, buyPrice can be set to a very large value, causing an overflow in amount, granting arbitrary tokens to the caller.

The sell function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The caller's balance is decreased by amount, totalSupply is decreased by amount, and the caller is sent a value in Wei, amount * sellPrice can be set to a very large value, causing an overflow in the caller's balance, granting arbitrary tokens to the caller.
